changelog:
Initial release of frompdf API skill.

- Extracts structured content from any PDF: headings, paragraphs, tables, lists, metadata, and more.
- Supports multiple output formats: semantic AST (JSON), Markdown, HTML, plain text, and LLM-ready chunks.
- No page limit; handles encrypted and complex PDFs.
- Provides semantic diff between two PDFs and PDF readability scoring.
- Requires FROMPDF_API_KEY; first 10 credits free with registration.
summary: PDF extraction API for AI agents and LLM pipelines. Converts any PDF into semantic AST, markdown, HTML, plain text, or LLM-ready chunks — no page limit. Also...
